primary_sources: provisional_reference: aquaponics_master_reference_summary.md (uploaded project reference; repo-relative path unconfirmed)
source_basis.ownership_note: Canonical translation rules from biological outputs into billable business outputs.

conversion_assumptions.name: average_saleable_head_mass
conversion_assumptions.assumption_note: Only needed if runtime outputs lack saleable head count and later fallback conversion is allowed.

rules.notes: Do not price total biomass as saleable heads unless a reviewed conversion basis exists.
rules.activation_note: Depends on saleable_harvest_count, which remains an optional future upstream field in this contract pass.

rules.notes: Simplest first-pass basil revenue path when product is sold by bulk harvested mass.

conversion_assumptions.name: average_saleable_bunch_mass
conversion_assumptions.assumption_note: Needed only if bunch counts are unavailable and the project later chooses mass-to-bunch conversion.

rules.notes: Keep bunch pricing optional until runtime outputs or post-harvest rules support a stable bunch count basis.
rules.activation_note: Depends on bunch-count-ready upstream output or a reviewed mass-to-bunch conversion basis.

conversion_assumptions.name: processed_yield_fraction
conversion_assumptions.assumption_note: Only needed if business pricing later uses processed yield rather than the harvested biomass basis.

rules.notes: Do not mix live-weight and processed-yield pricing in a single record.

conversion_assumptions.name: maximum_same_day_sale_window
conversion_assumptions.assumption_note: Needed later for channels where freshness window changes realized revenue or shrink.

rules.notes: This rule exists so later margin calculations do not ignore harvest timing.
rules.activation_note: Keep deferred until the project chooses harvest-only versus delivery-window revenue recognition and confirms any channel-specific timing fields.
